description.en: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-Audio, loaded from the llama.cpp-format GGUF components Liquid publishes. ASR: a FastConformer encoder feeds an LFM2 hybrid short-conv/attention backbone. TTS: the backbone generates audio frames through a depthformer, and an LFM2 detokenizer and ISTFT turn them into 24 kHz audio. S2S: a spoken question goes in as for ASR, and the reply comes out as interleaved text and audio.
description.zh: Liquid AI 的 LFM2.5-Audio，使用 Liquid 发布的 llama.cpp 格式 GGUF 组件加载。ASR：FastConformer 编码器接入 LFM2 混合短卷积/注意力骨干。TTS：骨干通过 depthformer 生成音频帧，再由 LFM2 detokenizer 与 ISTFT 转为 24 kHz 音频。S2S：语音问题按 ASR 方式输入，回复以文本与音频交错输出。

language.en: Must match the checkpoint's language (en or ja) when given; each published checkpoint transcribes and speaks one language.
language.zh: 提供时必须与检查点语言一致（en 或 ja）；每个已发布检查点只转写并说一种语言。

max_tokens.en: ASR: transcript tokens per audio chunk, 512 by default. TTS: audio frames (80 ms each) per text chunk, 512 by default. S2S: text tokens and audio frames of the reply together, 1024 by default. A transcript, a text chunk's speech or a reply that reaches it is cut off there, with a warning on stderr.
max_tokens.zh: ASR：每个音频分块的转写 token 数，默认 512。TTS：每个文本分块的音频帧数（每帧 80 ms），默认 512。S2S：回复的文本 token 与音频帧合计，默认 1024。达到上限的转写、文本分块语音或回复会被截断，并在 stderr 给出警告。

audio_chunk_mode.en: Audio chunking mode. auto transcribes input up to audio_chunk_duration_sec whole and splits longer input at pauses found by the bundled VAD (fixed chunks when the VAD model is absent); vad always splits at pauses and skips silence; fixed cuts every audio_chunk_duration_sec; none transcribes the whole input at once.
audio_chunk_mode.zh: 音频分块模式。auto 将不超过 audio_chunk_duration_sec 的输入整体转写，更长输入在内置 VAD 检测到的停顿处切分（缺少 VAD 模型时按固定分块）；vad 始终在停顿处切分并跳过静音；fixed 每 audio_chunk_duration_sec 切分；none 一次转写整个输入。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Longest chunk in seconds, at least 1. With fixed chunks, a final piece shorter than 1 second joins the previous chunk.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 最长分块时长（秒），至少 1。固定分块时，最后不足 1 秒的片段并入前一分块。

temperature.en: TTS and S2S: audio code sampling temperature, 0.8 by default for TTS and 1.0 for S2S; 0 picks the most likely code.
temperature.zh: TTS 与 S2S：音频 code 采样温度，TTS 默认 0.8，S2S 默认 1.0；0 选择最可能的 code。

top_k.en: TTS and S2S: sample audio codes from the k most likely, 64 by default for TTS and 4 for S2S; 0 keeps all, 1 is greedy.
top_k.zh: TTS 与 S2S：从最可能的 k 个音频 code 中采样，TTS 默认 64，S2S 默认 4；0 保留全部，1 为贪心。

text_temperature.en: S2S: text token sampling temperature; 0, the default, picks the most likely token, as liquid-audio's README and demo do.
text_temperature.zh: S2S：文本 token 采样温度；默认 0 选择最可能的 token，与 liquid-audio README 和演示一致。

text_top_k.en: S2S: with a text_temperature above 0, sample text tokens from the k most likely; 0, the default, keeps all, and 1 is greedy.
text_top_k.zh: S2S：text_temperature 大于 0 时，从最可能的 k 个文本 token 中采样；默认 0 保留全部，1 为贪心。

seed.en: TTS and S2S: sampling seed; omitted requests choose a random seed. TTS text chunk i uses seed + i. S2S text sampling draws from a stream of its own, so with the same seed a reply follows the greedy-text reply until a text token differs.
seed.zh: TTS 与 S2S：采样随机种子；省略时随机选择。TTS 第 i 个文本分块使用 seed + i。S2S 文本采样使用独立随机流，因此在相同种子下，回复会与贪心文本回复一致，直到某个文本 token 不同。

text_chunk_mode.en: TTS: long-form text chunking mode; japanese for the Japanese checkpoint and default otherwise when omitted.
text_chunk_mode.zh: TTS：长文本分块模式；日语检查点使用 japanese，否则省略时使用 default。

text_chunk_size.en: TTS: maximum Unicode codepoints per text chunk, each spoken as its own turn.
text_chunk_size.zh: TTS：每个文本分块的最大 Unicode 码点数，每块作为独立回合朗读。

stream_frames_per_event.en: TTS and S2S streaming: audio frames (80 ms each) per event; each event's audio is final. ASR runs offline only.
stream_frames_per_event.zh: TTS 与 S2S 流式：每个事件的音频帧数（每帧 80 ms）；每个事件的音频都是最终结果。ASR 仅离线运行。

return_codes.en: S2S: also return the reply's text tokens and audio codes as an lfm2_audio.reply artifact, to send back as history with the conversation's next turn.
return_codes.zh: S2S：同时返回回复的文本 token 与音频 code，形成 lfm2_audio.reply 产物，可在下一轮对话中作为历史传回。
